analysis: Disabling eager registry execution removed one unsafe compiler phase but did not remove compilation; the required profile forward pass still resolved uncached model-selected TileLang kernels after full weight and B12X-plan residency.
B12X preparation itself accumulated reclaimable accelerator scratch: MemAvailable fell near 1 GiB and driver allocations failed before later recovering near 9-10 GiB.
The old orchestration armed memguard only after API readiness, leaving exactly this startup interval unprotected.
The preserved container log ends after KV allocation and graph-mode selection, so the final control loss cannot be attributed more narrowly without the unavailable previous-boot journals.
decision: reject the patch-0022 image and deferred-first-use configuration
do not launch another candidate until the hosts receive physical recovery and the owner explicitly resumes hardware work
compile captured model/backend JIT registrations before checkpoint weight residency
reclaim compiler scratch between pre-profile B12X units
pre-arm a protected fail-closed startup memguard before every container launch and monitor it through API readiness
require bounded build and single-node compilation checks before any future coordinated TP3 startup
